_provenance.note: Sidecar for stardust/current/DESIGN.md. Carries what the DESIGN.md frontmatter schema cannot hold: shadows, breakpoints, component snippets, narrative, and stardust's componentStyle/motifs/voice extensions.

nab-red.note: Brand colour and primary action, but NOT the conversion colour — see action-green.

action-green.note: Appears 3 times across 5 pages. Two on one page would be a defect.

banking-slate.note: Used by exactly one element site-wide: the header's Internet Banking selector.

page-grey.note: Measured from body computed style and confirmed at 47% of sampled home-page pixels.

typographyMeta.licensing: SIL OFL 1.1 — freely self-hostable on a target domain
typographyMeta.coverage: 4126 of 4131 captured visible elements resolve to this stack

scaleAudit.note: Not a modular scale. Sizes sit on a 4px grid; weight carries the hierarchy.

card.note: Non-directional grey halo; pairs with a 1px #B3B3B3 border which does the actual separating.

shadows.philosophy: flat-with-one-shadow — no elevation scale exists; depth is tonal layering (black header / grey page / white card)

breakpoints.note: This extraction rendered at 1440x900 @2x only. Responsive behaviour is UNMEASURED; any downstream work needing mobile must re-capture.

motion.note: Pages were rendered with prefers-reduced-motion: reduce, so transitions and scroll behaviour were deliberately suppressed. Motion is unmeasured. One dynamic behaviour WAS observed indirectly: the home and /personal mastheads rotate campaign slides server-side per request.

buttonConversion.rule: one per page, on the highest-intent action

buttonOnRed.rule: used only where the surface behind is NAB red

buttonTertiary.note: the most common action on the site — an underlined red text link with a trailing chevron

card.affordance: red right-chevron pinned to the right of the title row

motifs.signature: The NAB six-point star — logo, hole punched through walls in photography, outlined line-motif across the /business masthead, and printed on the cards.
motifs.photography: Editorial, warmly lit, people-centred, staged around the star. Studio lighting rigs are deliberately left in frame, so the imagery reads as knowingly constructed rather than documentary.
motifs.imageDelivery: Every hero and card image is an / at 1440x480 rendered. Zero CSS background images across all 5 captured pages.

voice.heroHeadline: Ready for a new everyday account?
ctaSamples: Explore ways to bank with us
voice.register: Second person, present tense, plainly reassuring. Names the reader's situation before the product; 7 of 17 captured section headings are questions. Promises are unhedged then immediately qualified by a separate compliance sentence. Effort is quantified.
antiReferences: no superlatives in NAB's own voice
no urgency devices beyond dated promotional terms

rules: One typeface; weight carries hierarchy (300 display / 700 card titles / 600 links).
Exactly one green action per page.
Never a red button on a red surface — switch to black.
No gradients, no pills, no second family, no letter-spacing adjustments.
The red chevron is the universal 'there is more here' mark.
The compliance sentence sits under the promise at the same size.
